The order is coded once, in AgentModel.Resolve, and the daemon and a CLI-launched session (h9k task start, h9k task delegate) both call it. The review-verify and final-pass knobs sit beneath the project too: those passes check the task, then the project, then their own knob, then review\\u0027s chain, so a project model is a blanket statement with no hidden holes. The courier follows the same chain above its Sonnet floor, so a project model chosen for builds also lifts the courier over a node\\u0027s cheaper courier choice. A project\\u0027s model is node-scoped and never travels, so only the node\\u0027s own operator sets it, overriding their own per-role table. Everything else in the superseded decision holds: the AgentModel value object, the meaning of the single word default, roles as first-class, every dispatch recording the model it ran on, and a resumed session keeping its model.\u0022,\u0022OriginIncident\u0022:\u00222026-09-26, hall9k#592 and PR #593 (task f8fe7435): the per-role effort chain built in 6fe2f5a2 reads task, project, node role, node-wide, model default, and Brian ruled the model chain must read the same, with the project above the node\\u0027s per-role table rather than beneath it (the deferred alternative in the superseded decision, now reachable because a node has a config home); ruling on the pass knobs 13:0x EDT, option (a)\u0022,\u0022Supersedes\u0022:[\u002201a0c941-fb35-7473-a9a0-02bd9afdb968\u0022],\u0022Provenance\u0022:{\u0022RecordedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022RunId\u0022:null,\u0022TaskId\u0022:null,\u0022Attendance\u0022:\u0022Unobserved\u0022,\u0022IsFromRun\u0022:false},\u0022RecordedAt\u0022:\u00222026-09-26T17:40:08.788846\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022LegacyId\u0022:null}","originEventId":"afc5a4ed-569a-4902-8cd1-c772f2fedf5f","originSequence":67081,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-09-26T17:40:08.907007+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
